body.en:
Question B-007-008-011.

Why the correct answer is right: Meteor scatter works best in the lower VHF range; 30 MHz to 100 MHz covers the most effective range named here.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "10 MHz to 30 MHz": 10 MHz to 30 MHz is HF through the lower edge of VHF and is generally below the most effective meteor-scatter range.
- sourceIndex 2: "3 MHz to 10 MHz": 3 MHz to 10 MHz is much too low and is dominated by ordinary HF ionospheric propagation.
- sourceIndex 3: "100 MHz to 150 MHz": 100 MHz to 150 MHz is higher VHF where meteor trails are usually less effective for extended-range communication.
